description.value: Uva Wine & Cocktail Bar is an award-winning downtown Vancouver institution occupying a dual identity: a European-inspired caffè bar by day serving handcrafted coffees, fresh juices, and small plates, and a celebrated wine and cocktail destination by night. Located at the heart of Vancouver's cultural and entertainment district, it has garnered numerous industry awards for its seasonal cocktail and wine program. Part of the Viaggio Hospitality group, it also offers a private dining room (the Madonna Room) for up to 12 guests.
